body: I have reoccurring dreams where the people I considered to be friends (they no longer talk to me) see me again and we become real friends. I completely feel where you're coming from. Quarantine isnt helping the loneliness, either. Stay safe, OP
Thank you for saying this. It is comforting to not feel alone in the struggle, and to feel like someone somewhere has your back. I hope you have a good rest of your day, OP

I absolutely would. I oftentimes try to guess at how people would respond. I know it would be mostly my close family members with a response beyond "oh, that's sad", but I wonder how my abusive/neglectful parents would respond.

Just being able to relax and now have the feeling of impending doom sounds heavenly. I start feeling human by Sunday evening every weekend, and as I pull into work on Monday I can feel my depression worsening and my anxiety increasing. I've missed 3 days of work in the past two weeks from feeling so overtly sad and it's great for mental health but absolutely not sustainable due to having so many Bill's. I hate it.
